tenderSchedule.title: Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of 220kV SF6 gas circuit breakers for KPCL Hydro Projects
tenderSchedule.description: Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of 220kV SF6 gas circuit breakers for KPCL Hydro Projects along with transportation, supply of essential spares, dismantling existing structure, grouting etc.,
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Chief Engineer ED office Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: CEED Office, #3, 3rd Floor KPCL office building Palace Road Bengaluru-560001.

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be a regular manufacturer of 220kV & above class SF6 gas circuit breakers in India. As a proof of this, the bidder shall produce the copy of factory license (form-3) or certificate of incorporation (form-1) or company registration certificate to satisfy the qualification criteria.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Factory License (Form-3) or Certificate of incorporation (Form-1) or Company Registration Certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have designed, manufactured, supplied and commissioned at least 11Nos. of 220 kV or higher capacity spring- spring type of SF6 gas circuit breakers having work order value of Rs.2.70 Crores at power plant / sub-station in India and the same shall be satisfactorily performing for a minimum period of one year during the preceding 5 years from the date of issue of NIT. As a proof of this, bidder shall furnish performance certificate issued by an officer of the rank of chief engineer or station superintendent / competent authority of respective power station/sub-station along with work order copy.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Satisfactory performance certificate along with work order copy

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have a minimum annual turnover of Rs.11Crores for at least two financial years during the preceding five years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof of this, the Bidder shall furnish a copy of Turn Over Certificate / P&L statements / annual report duly audited and certified by the Chartered accountant and bearing valid UDIN.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Turn Over Certificate / P&L statements / annual report duly audited and certified by the Chartered accountant

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall hold a valid Super Grade Electrical Contractors License issued by Government of Karnataka and shall have carried out Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of 220kV SF6 gas circuit breakers including dismantling of existing breakers in India during the preceding five years from date of tender opening. As a proof of this, bidder shall furnish a valid Super Grade Electrical Contractors license and work done certificate issued by an officer of the rank of Chief Engineer or Station Superintendent / Competent Authority of the Power Station/Sub-station along with copy of corresponding work order/s. OR If the intending bidder does not hold valid Super Grade Electrical Contractors License issued by Government of Karnataka, he shall give an undertaking that under bidder supervision, the dismantling, erection, testing & commissioning activity of SF6 Circuit breaker will be executed at site by a Sub-contractor having following: a) Past experience of works carried out for Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of 220kV SF6 gas circuit breakers including dismantling of existing breakers in India during the preceding five years from date of tender opening and b) Valid Super grade Electrical contractor License issued by the Government of Karnataka. As a proof of this, Schedule-G shall be furnished.
technicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Super Grade Electrical Contractors License or Schedule-G undertaking

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Super Grade Electrical Contractors License or Schedule-G undertaking

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall not have been subjected to forfeiture of EMD/foreclosure/termination of their Contract in KPCL or Government or any other utility or shall not have been blacklisted for participating in tender by KPCL, Government, or any other utility in India during the past three years. As a proof of this, the Bidder shall furnish the notarized declaration to satisfy the above as specified in Schedule-E.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of 220kV SF6 gas circuit breakers for KPCL Hydro Projects

itemList.description: Design, Engineering, manufacture, quality surveillance, testing at manufacturer works, supply, transportation, arranging transit insurance, delivery on FOR destination basis of  245 kV SF6 gas circuit breakers spring - spring operated  along with support structures, Mounting adoptor plate (if required) and terminal connectors & all required accessories for Sharavathy generating station (9Nos), Gerusoppa Power house (3Nos) and Varahi underground Power house (10Nos)
Supply of essential spares required for switchyard equipments should be supplied as per clause No. 4.25.00 of Section IV of the bid document

Unloading at  contractor's store yard as and when received at project site , proper storage, handling, transporation to site of erection, erection, testing and commissioning of  245 kV SF6 gas circuit breakers spring - spring operated with support structures and terminal connectors & all required accessories including dismantling of exsisting Circuit Breakers & shifting to KPCL stores for Sharavathy generating station (9Nos), Gerusoppa Power house (3Nos) and Varahi underground Power house (10Nos)

Demolition of existing foundation, strengthening of the pedestals by grouting and also the extra re inforcement, lapping should be done and RCC concrete should be made if necessary as required by the site requirement by for existing pedestals for erection of new switchyard equipments supplied.
